Reranking with an empty query string

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import RerankRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = RerankRequest.from_json("{\"documents\":[\"Some document\",\"Another document\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"\"}")
    result = await client.rerank(request)
    print(result.results)

asyncio.run(main())
```
